content: Shaurya Joshi asks Neha Kapoor to explain the differences between his old and new insurance policies. Neha clarifies that the new policy adds dental and vision coverage but increases the premium by 15%. After Shaurya asks about negotiating the price, Neha consults her team and offers a one-time 5% discount if he upgrades within the next 48 hours.

action_items: Customer to decide on policy upgrade within the next 48 hours to receive the 5% discount
